summary: Today’s PaymentsDive recap: 8 new stories, with focus on regulation, product + fintech innovation.

articles.title: Same-day ACH payments swell in Q2
articles.description: Nacha attributes the growth to financial firms’ increasing demand for faster payments.

articles.title: Opening the Fed’s payment rails
articles.description: “Supervision will need to answer practical questions: what operational resilience should be required before a participant touches core payment infrastructure?” wonders an SRM industry consultant.

articles.title: Augustus aims to speed payments
articles.description: The company received FDIC approval in its quest to create a bank that moves beyond the legacy approach to settlements.

articles.title: Fiserv flags Clover revenue drop
articles.description: The payments processor said a slowdown in the merchant service unit’s hardware sale is negatively impacting results.

articles.title: Block explores how to price AI
articles.description: Cash App’s parent is focused on customer adoption of its AI tools before deciding how it will monetize those offerings, CEO Jack Dorsey said.

articles.title: Toast aims to drive AI into dining
articles.description: Most restaurants don’t have time to leverage AI tools, Toast executives say, anticipating profit from helping operators reap efficiencies.

articles.title: Visa, Mastercard join another stablecoin group
articles.description: The card networks are keeping their options open with respect to stablecoin communities, locking arms with Circle on its latest effort.

articles.title: FIS seeks to sell parts of capital markets unit
articles.description: The banking and payments services company floated the plan to offload pieces of the business after sales declined for that segment.
